# Upstream workflow references

These workflows were imported from Kiwix Android commit `111a92799fb17da7728ea829bb04a36c53b66d78` for provenance. They remain outside `.github/workflows/` so the course repository does not execute upstream publishing jobs or its full device matrix.

The active course workflow is `../workflows/course-ci.yml`. Moving these references back into the execution directory requires a separate review of their triggers, permissions, credentials and intended targets.
